title: 300 arrested, 73 brought back in a year

ai.summary: Central security agencies reported over 300 arrests and deportation of 73 high-value fugitives in a year-long crackdown following the Red Fort blast, which involved a 'Doctor Module' of highly educated professionals.

facts.quote: the deportation of 73 high-value fugitives from abroad

ai.background_note: The Red Fort blast in November 2025 exposed a 'Doctor Module' network involving highly educated professionals, leading to a year-long crackdown that resulted in over 300 arrests and deportation of 73 fugitives.

problems: quote not in article: “the officials said on Monday.”
